name: opwebrtc
description: Librería WebRTC agnóstica a frameworks para videollamadas personalizables, seguras y ligeras

scripts.build: npm run build -w @opwebrtc/core && npm run build -w @opwebrtc/react && npm run build -w @opwebrtc/vue && npm run build -w @opwebrtc/angular
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @opwebrtc/core && npm run typecheck -w @opwebrtc/signaling-server && npm run typecheck -w @opwebrtc/react && npm run typecheck -w @opwebrtc/vue && npm run typecheck -w @opwebrtc/angular
